mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an active monetary easing cycle that lowers discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% indicates persistent labor market tightness that drives wage inflation and corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (below 0.2%) and rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL above 225) indicates central bank response to inflation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2 and CPIAUCSL > 225.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 225), declining housing starts (HOUST < 700) signals cooling demand for residential construction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225 and HOUST < 700.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction permits above 700 (HOUST > 700) indicate strong housing demand that precedes economic expansion and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 700.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 96.0 (INDPRO < 96.0) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 96.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS > 132000 and UNRATE < 8.0) indicate robust hiring and wage growth that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 132000 and UNRATE < 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Declining consumer credit (RSAFS < 400000) signals reduced household borrowing for consumption, which typically precedes weaker retail sales and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS falls below 400,000.
